comment: E2E roleplay: 3 role-specific sql_query tools + path-based skills with references. Setup done via chained sql_query nodes (one statement each), no external scripts. Log nodes used as sequencing barriers between setup steps.

data.q_create_inventory: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roleplay_t22.inventory (sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, qty INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reorder_point INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10)
data.q_create_transactions: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roleplay_t22.transactions (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT NOT NULL, qty_delta INT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())
data.q_seed_inventory: INSERT INTO roleplay_t22.inventory (sku, name, qty, reorder_point) VALUES ('ABC-001', 'Widget Premium', 100, 20), ('ABC-002', 'Widget Standard', 5, 10), ('XYZ-999', 'Gadget Deluxe', 50, 15), ('DEF-100', 'Tool Basic', 8, 25) ON CONFLICT (sku) DO NOTHING
data.q_seed_transactions: INSERT INTO roleplay_t22.transactions (sku, qty_delta, kind) VALUES ('ABC-001', -10, 'sale'), ('ABC-002', -3, 'sale'), ('XYZ-999', -5, 'sale'), ('ABC-001', 20, 'purchase')

config.system_message: You are an inventory operations assistant with three role-specific tools: cargar_inventario (record stock movements), consultar_ventas (analyze sales data), and monitor_stock (identify items below reorder point). A single user request may require multiple tools in sequence — for example, identifying critical stock (monitor_stock) and then recording the purchase to replenish it (cargar_inventario). Always describe a tool the first time you need it to see its playbook, then chain the tools yourself to fulfill the user's intent end-to-end. Do not ask the user to invoke a tool manually — you have access to all three; switch between them as needed.

cargar_inventario.name: cargar_inventario
cargar_inventario.description: Record inventory movements (purchases, sales, returns, adjustments).
cargar_inventario.summary: Insert into transactions + update inventory.qty for a SKU.

query.description: SQL DML statement(s) that record the movement.

consultar_ventas.name: consultar_ventas
consultar_ventas.description: Analyze sales and stock movement data (read-only).
consultar_ventas.summary: SELECT queries over transactions and inventory tables.

monitor_stock.name: monitor_stock
monitor_stock.description: Identify items below their reorder point (read-only).

config.prompt: ¿Qué productos están por debajo del punto de reorden? Si hay alguno crítico, registra una compra de 30 unidades para reponerlo.
